commit.message:
Pipeline large RoCEnante all-reduces as chunked two-shot reductions

One-shot sends every peer the whole message, so above about 1 MiB its cost
grows with world - 1 copies on the wire, and staging, transfer and reduction
run back to back. Messages from a world-dependent threshold (2 MiB on two
ranks, 1 MiB on more) up to the new pipe_bytes capacity now run as a
reduce-scatter and an all-gather in one launch: each rank's shard is split
into chunks, the kernel publishes a ready word per chunk as it stages or
reduces it, and the proxy posts each chunk as soon as its word turns. Each
rank sends 2 (world - 1) / world of the message, with staging and reduction
hidden behind the wire. Shards are reduced by their owners in rank order
with FP32 accumulation, so the result is bitwise the one-shot result on
every rank.

The two-shot area needs one buffer instead of two slots: a rank leaves op N
only after every peer's all-gather of N, which each peer sent after reducing
all of our chunks of N. Each slot's record now carries the op kind, so a
proxy catching up on two doorbells posts each op its own way. A chunk is
never published after a wait timed out, so a poisoned rank cannot send an
unreduced shard that a peer would accept.

DGX Sparks on one 200 GbE switch, BF16, 20-op CUDA graphs, maximum over
ranks of the median replay (benchmark_roce_twoshot.py), before -> after,
with NCCL 2.29.7 for reference:

  ranks  size    one-shot    two-shot   NCCL
  2      4 MiB    259 us      221 us     748 us
  2      32 MiB  2335 us     1428 us    1712 us
  2      64 MiB     -        2852 us    4045 us
  3      32 MiB  3760 us     1939 us    2005 us
  3      64 MiB     -        3774 us    4810 us
  4      4 MiB    664 us      325 us    1024 us
  4      32 MiB  5281 us     2143 us    2242 us
  4      64 MiB     -        4218 us    4456 us

About 96% of the wire from 16 MiB up. Pinned memory for a 64 MiB two-shot
capacity is 192 MiB at four ranks, against 640 MiB for one-shot slots of
that size.

+
+Launch one rank per host with torchrun, for example on four Sparks::
+
+    NCCL_IB_HCA=rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0 NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \\
+    torchrun --nnodes=4 --nproc-per-node=1 --node-rank=$RANK \\
+        --master-addr=$MASTER --master-port=29650 \\
+        benchmarks/experimental/b12x/benchmark_roce_twoshot.py --output roce.json
+
+BF16 messages; each path is first checked against an FP32 reference and for
+bitwise agreement across ranks (and one-shot against two-shot), then timed as
+20-op CUDA graphs: the median replay per rank, maximum over ranks.

+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+import statistics
+import time

+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+
+ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+ap.add_argument("--sizes-kib", default="1024,2048,4096,8192,16384,32768,65536")
+ap.add_argument("--paths", default="oneshot,twoshot,nccl")
+ap.add_argument("--max-mib", type=int, default=32)
+ap.add_argument("--pipe-mib", type=int, default=64)
+ap.add_argument("--pipe-blocks", type=int, default=None)
+ap.add_argument("--chunk-kib", type=int, default=None)
+ap.add_argument("--ops", type=int, default=20)
+ap.add_argument("--reps", type=int, default=10)
+ap.add_argument("--output", default="")
+ap.add_argument(
+    "--auto", action="store_true", help="also time the runtime's own size routing"
+)
+args = ap.parse_args()
+
+dist.init_process_group("gloo")
+rank, world = dist.get_rank(), dist.get_world_size()
+device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+
+from b12x.comm import roce
+from b12x.comm.roce import _preparation
+from b12x.preparation import PreparationSession, PreparedCall
+
+
+def log(msg):
+    if rank == 0:

+
+
+runtime = roce.AllReduce(
+    exchange_group=dist.group.WORLD,
+    device=device,
+    max_size=args.max_mib << 20,
+    max_gather_bytes=1 << 20,
+    pipe_bytes=args.pipe_mib << 20,
+    **({} if args.pipe_blocks is None else {"pipe_blocks": args.pipe_blocks}),
+    **({} if args.chunk_kib is None else {"pipe_chunk_bytes": args.chunk_kib << 10}),
+)
+query = roce.query_from_runtime(
+    runtime,
+    surface="AllReduce.all_reduce",
+    call={"dtypes": ("bfloat16",)},
+    topology="roce_rdma",
+    peer_hosts=tuple(f"rank-{r}" for r in range(world)),
+)
+plan = roce.plan(query, runtime=runtime)
+seed = torch.zeros(8, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+
+
+def prepare(state):
+    call = _preparation.prepared_call(state, inp=seed)
+    return PreparedCall(run=call.run)
+
+
+session = PreparationSession(device=device, autotune=False, compile_workers=2)
+session.prepare((plan.request(name="roce", prepare_call=prepare),))

+    f"runtime ready: {json.dumps({k: v for k, v in runtime.stats().items() if 'pipe' in k or k in ('rails', 'max_size')})}"
+)
+
+paths = args.paths.split(",") + (["auto"] if args.auto else [])
+default_threshold = runtime.pipe_threshold

+
+

+    if path == "nccl":

+
+        return op
+    runtime.pipe_threshold = {"twoshot": 1, "oneshot": 1 << 62}.get(

+
+    def op():
+        runtime.all_reduce(inp, out=out, plan=plan)
+
+    return op
+
+
+def digest(t):
+    return hashlib.sha1(t.view(torch.uint8).cpu().numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest()[:12]
+
+
+rows = []
+stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+for kib in (int(s) for s in args.sizes_kib.split(",")):
+    nbytes = kib << 10
+    numel = nbytes // 2
+    gen = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(rank + 17)
+    inp = torch.randn(numel, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device, generator=gen)
+    expected = torch.zeros(numel, dtype=torch.float32, device=device)
+    for peer in range(world):
+        g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(peer + 17)
+        expected.add_(
+            torch.randn(numel, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device, generator=g).float()
+        )
+    expected = expected.to(torch.bfloat16)
+    row = {"bytes": nbytes}
+    digests = {}
+    for path in paths:
+        if path == "oneshot" and nbytes > runtime.max_size:
+            continue
+        if path in ("twoshot", "auto") and nbytes > runtime.pipe_bytes:
+            continue
+        out = torch.empty_like(inp)
+        if path == "nccl":
+            out.copy_(inp)
+        op = make_op(path, inp, out)
+        op()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        err = (out.float() - expected.float()).abs().max().item()
+        same = [None] * world

+        if path != "nccl":
+            digests[path] = same[0]
+            if len(set(same)) != 1 or err > 0.07:
+                raise SystemExit(

+                )
+        # graph: in-place NCCL keeps growing values; correctness was checked eagerly
+        stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+        with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+            op()
+            op()
+        torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+        with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream):
+            for _ in range(args.ops):
+                op()
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        if path != "nccl":
+            gerr = (out.float() - expected.float()).abs().max().item()
+            if gerr > 0.07:
+                raise SystemExit(f"rank {rank} {path} {nbytes}: graph err {gerr}")
+        samples = []
+        for _ in range(args.reps):
+            dist.barrier()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            begin = time.perf_counter()
+            graph.replay()
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            samples.append((time.perf_counter() - begin) / args.ops * 1e6)
+        times = [None] * world
+        dist.all_gather_object(times, statistics.median(samples))
+        row[path] = round(max(times), 1)
+        row[path + "_err"] = round(err, 4)
+        runtime.check_health()
+        del graph
+    if "oneshot" in digests and "twoshot" in digests:
+        row["bitwise_equal"] = digests["oneshot"] == digests["twoshot"]
+    rows.append(row)
+    if rank == 0:
+        busbw = {
+            p: round(2 * (world - 1) / world * nbytes / row[p] / 1e3, 1)
+            for p in paths
+            if p in row
+        }
+        log(
+            f"{kib:6d} KiB  "
+            + "  ".join(f"{p} {row[p]:8.1f} us" for p in paths if p in row)
+            + f"  busbw GB/s {busbw}"
+            + (
+                f"  bitwise1v2 {row.get('bitwise_equal')}"
+                if "bitwise_equal" in row
+                else ""
+            )
+        )
+if rank == 0 and args.output:
+    json.dump(
+        {
+            "world": world,
+            "args": vars(args),
+            "rows": rows,
+            "stats": {
+                k: v
+                for k, v in runtime.stats().items()
+                if isinstance(v, (int, float, str, list))
+            },
+        },
+        open(args.output, "w"),
+        indent=1,
+    )
+runtime.close()
+dist.barrier()
+dist.destroy_process_group()

+"""CuTe DSL kernel for the RoCE pipelined two-shot all-reduce.
+
+One launch performs a complete all-reduce of a large message as a
+reduce-scatter followed by an all-gather, so each rank puts
+``2 (world - 1) / world`` of the message on the wire instead of the one-shot's
+``world - 1`` copies.  Rank ``j`` owns shard ``j`` (packs
+``[j P / world, (j + 1) P / world)``), and every shard is split into the same
+number of chunks so that staging, the wire and the reduction overlap:
+
+1. doorbell: block 0 records the op (two-shot kind, bytes, chunk geometry) in
+   ``seq & 1``'s slot of the control record and rings ``seq``;
+2. stage: blocks copy chunk ``c`` of every peer's shard into ``pipe_send``; the
+   last block to finish a chunk publishes ``ready_rs[c] = seq`` and the proxy
+   writes that chunk to its owners;
+3. reduce: per chunk of our shard, wait for every peer's stripe flags, sum the
+   local input and the peers' chunks in fixed rank order, store the result in
+   the output and in ``pipe_send``; the last block to finish publishes
+   ``ready_ag[c] = seq`` and the proxy sends the reduced chunk to every peer;
+4. gather: per chunk, wait for every peer's reduced chunk and copy it into the
+   output;
+5. epoch: the last block to finish advances the shared device epoch.
+
+Every shard is reduced by its owner only, so all ranks hold identical bits, and
+the arithmetic (FP32 accumulation in rank order) matches the one-shot kernel.
+The chunk counters are free-running, which keeps the grid size a power of two
+fixed per runtime.  No block waits for another block, so the grid needs no
+co-residency.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
+import cutlass
+import cutlass.cute as cute
+from cutlass import Int32, Int64, Uint32
+import torch
+
+from b12x._lib.compiler import KernelCompileSpec
+from b12x._lib.compiler import compile as b12x_compile
+from b12x._lib.compile_plan import attach_programs
+from b12x._lib.program_cache import program_cache
+from b12x._lib.runtime_control import raise_if_kernel_resolution_frozen
+from b12x._lib.utils import current_cuda_stream, make_ptr
+
+from ._cute_intrinsics import (
+    atomic_add_relaxed_gpu_u32,
+    fence_sc_gpu,
+    fence_sc_sys,
+    ld_global_v4_u32,
+    ld_relaxed_gpu_u32,
+    ld_relaxed_sys_u32,
+    ld_relaxed_sys_v4_u32,
+    spin_until_eq_acquire_sys,
+    st_global_v4_u32,
+    st_release_gpu_u32,
+    st_relaxed_sys_u32,
+)
+from ._oneshot_cute import _DTYPE_NAMES, _RoceOneshotLaunch, PACK_BYTES
+
+# Control-record words (see _roce_proxy.c).
+_CTRL_SLOT_KIND = 8
+_CTRL_SLOT_CHUNK_PACKS = 10
+_CTRL_SLOT_CHUNKS = 12
+_CTRL_READY_RS = 64
+_CTRL_READY_AG = 128
+_PREPARED_LAUNCHERS: set[tuple[object, ...]] = set()
+
+
+class _RoceTwoshotLaunch(_RoceOneshotLaunch):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dtype_name: str,
+        world_size: int,
+        rank: int,
+        threads: int,
+        flag_stride: int,
+        hca_count: int,
+        max_chunks: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        """Bind one specialization: dtype, world size, rank, and layout constants."""
+        super().__init__(
+            dtype_name, world_size, rank, threads, 1, flag_stride, hca_count
+        )
+        self._max_chunks = int(max_chunks)
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _shard_start(self, shard: Int32, size_packs: Int32) -> Int32:
+        """First pack of ``shard`` (the proxy splits identically)."""
+        return Int32((Int64(shard) * Int64(size_packs)) // Int64(self._world_size))
+
+    @cute.jit
+    def _wait_chunk(
+        self,
+        flag_base: Int64,
+        phase: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+        chunk: Int32,
+        seq: Uint32,
+        ctrl_base: Int64,
+        poison_ptr: Int64,
+        spin_limit: Uint32,
+    ) -> None:
+        """One thread per (peer, rail) waits for chunk ``chunk``'s stripe flag of ``phase``."""
+        tidx, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+        if Int32(tidx) < Int32(self._world_size * self._hca_count):
+            peer = Int32(tidx) // Int32(self._hca_count)
+            hca = Int32(tidx) - peer * Int32(self._hca_count)
+            if peer != Int32(self._rank):
+                flag_addr = flag_base + (
+                    (
+                        (Int64(phase * self._world_size) + Int64(peer))
+                        * Int64(self._max_chunks)
+                        + Int64(chunk)
+                    )
+                    * Int64(self._hca_count)
+                    + Int64(hca)
+                ) * Int64(self._flag_stride)
+                timed_out = spin_until_eq_acquire_sys(flag_addr, seq, spin_limit)
+                if timed_out != Uint32(0):
+                    st_relaxed_sys_u32(ctrl_base + Int64(12), Uint32(peer))
+                    st_relaxed_sys_u32(ctrl_base + Int64(24), Uint32(hca))
+                    st_relaxed_sys_u32(ctrl_base + Int64(8), seq)
+                    st_release_gpu_u32(poison_ptr, seq)
+

+"""Correctness tests for RoCEnante's pipelined two-shot all-reduce.
+
+Run with torchrun on two or more nodes that share a RoCE fabric, for example
+from every node of a DGX Spark cluster::
+
+    NCCL_IB_HCA=rocep1s0f0,roceP2p1s0f0 NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3 \\
+    torchrun --nnodes=4 --nproc-per-node=1 --node-rank=$RANK \\
+        --master-addr=$MASTER --master-port=29650 \\
+        -m pytest -x tests/experimental/b12x/comm/test_roce_twoshot_gpu.py
+
+Without a torchrun environment the tests skip.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import time
+from datetime import timedelta
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+from b12x.preparation import PreparationSession, PreparedCall
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    "WORLD_SIZE" not in os.environ or int(os.environ.get("WORLD_SIZE", "1")) < 2,
+    reason="requires a torchrun launch with WORLD_SIZE >= 2",
+)
+
+ONESHOT_MAX = 1 << 20
+PIPE_BYTES = 8 << 20
+DTYPES = ("bfloat16", "float32", "float16")
+
+
+class _Prepared:
+    """A runtime plus its published plan; ``all_reduce`` routes by the runtime's thresholds."""
+
+    def __init__(self, runtime, plan):
+        self.runtime, self.plan = runtime, plan
+
+    def all_reduce(self, inp, **kwargs):
+        return self.runtime.all_reduce(inp, plan=self.plan, **kwargs)
+
+    def oneshot(self, inp, **kwargs):
+        """Force the one-shot path (``inp`` must fit ``max_size``)."""
+        threshold, self.runtime.pipe_threshold = self.runtime.pipe_threshold, 1 << 62
+        try:
+            return self.all_reduce(inp, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            self.runtime.pipe_threshold = threshold
+
+    def twoshot(self, inp, **kwargs):
+        """Force the two-shot path."""
+        threshold, self.runtime.pipe_threshold = self.runtime.pipe_threshold, 1
+        try:
+            return self.all_reduce(inp, **kwargs)
+        finally:
+            self.runtime.pipe_threshold = threshold
+
+
+def _prepare(spin_limit: int | None = None, **kwargs) -> _Prepared:
+    """A prepared two-shot-capable runtime over the torchrun world."""
+    from b12x.comm import roce
+    from b12x.comm.roce import _preparation
+
+    if not roce.is_supported():
+        pytest.skip(
+            "RoCE all-reduce needs an integrated GPU with an active RDMA device"
+        )
+    if not dist.is_initialized():
+        dist.init_process_group("nccl", timeout=timedelta(seconds=60))
+    device = torch.device("cuda", 0)
+    torch.cuda.set_device(device)
+    previous = os.environ.get("B12X_ROCE_SPIN_LIMIT")
+    if spin_limit is not None:
+        os.environ["B12X_ROCE_SPIN_LIMIT"] = str(spin_limit)
+    try:
+        rt = roce.AllReduce(
+            exchange_group=dist.group.WORLD,
+            device=device,
+            max_size=ONESHOT_MAX,
+            max_gather_bytes=1 << 20,
+            pipe_bytes=PIPE_BYTES,
+            **kwargs,
+        )
+    finally:
+        if spin_limit is not None:
+            if previous is None:
+                del os.environ["B12X_ROCE_SPIN_LIMIT"]
+            else:
+                os.environ["B12X_ROCE_SPIN_LIMIT"] = previous
+    query = roce.query_from_runtime(
+        rt,
+        surface="AllReduce.all_reduce",
+        call={"dtypes": DTYPES},
+        topology="roce_rdma",
+        peer_hosts=tuple(f"rank-{r}" for r in range(rt.world_size)),
+    )
+    plan = roce.plan(query, runtime=rt)
+    seeds = [
+        torch.zeros(
+            16 // getattr(torch, d).itemsize, dtype=getattr(torch, d), device=device
+        )
+        for d in DTYPES
+    ]
+
+    def prepare(state):
+        calls = [_preparation.prepared_call(state, inp=seed) for seed in seeds]
+        return PreparedCall(run=lambda: [call.run() for call in calls])
+
+    with PreparationSession(
+        device=device, autotune=False, compile_workers=2
+    ) as session:
+        session.prepare((plan.request(name="roce", prepare_call=prepare),))
+    return _Prepared(rt, plan)

+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def runtime():
+    prepared = _prepare()

+    prepared.runtime.close()
+    dist.barrier()

+def _tolerance(dtype: torch.dtype, world: int) -> tuple[float, float]:
+    if dtype == torch.float32:
+        return 1e-5, 1e-5 * world
+    if dtype == torch.bfloat16:
+        return 1e-2, 2e-2 * world
+    return 2e-3, 4e-3 * world
+
+
+def _rank_identical(out: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    gathered = [torch.empty_like(out) for _ in range(dist.get_world_size())]
+    dist.all_gather(gathered, out)
+    for peer_out in gathered:
+        assert torch.equal(peer_out, out), "ranks must produce bit-identical output"

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [getattr(torch, d) for d in DTYPES])
+# 16 bytes leaves most ranks an empty shard; 16000 and 1 MiB + 48 split unevenly
+# across three ranks; 5 MiB spans every chunk flag of a 128 KiB-chunk shard on two.
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "nbytes", [16, 16000, 256 * 1024, (1 << 20) + 48, 5 << 20, PIPE_BYTES]
+)
+def test_twoshot_matches_nccl_and_oneshot(runtime, dtype, nbytes):
+    """Two-shot matches NCCL, is rank-identical, and is bitwise one-shot's result."""
+    world, rank = dist.get_world_size(), dist.get_rank()
+    numel = nbytes // dtype.itemsize
+    for trial in range(3):
+        torch.manual_seed(1000 * trial + rank)
+        inp = torch.randn(numel, dtype=dtype, device=runtime.runtime.device)
+        expected = inp.clone()
+        dist.all_reduce(expected)
+        out = runtime.twoshot(inp)
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        rtol, atol = _tolerance(dtype, world)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, expected, rtol=rtol, atol=atol)
+        _rank_identical(out)
+        if nbytes <= ONESHOT_MAX:
+            # Both reduce in FP32 in rank order and round once.
+            assert torch.equal(runtime.oneshot(inp), out)
+    runtime.runtime.check_health()

+def test_size_routing(runtime):
+    """Messages route by size alone: one-shot below the threshold, two-shot from it and above max_size."""
+    rt = runtime.runtime
+    below = min(rt.pipe_threshold, rt.max_size + 16) - 16
+    assert not rt._uses_pipe(below)
+    assert rt._uses_pipe(min(rt.pipe_threshold, rt.max_size + 16))
+    assert rt._uses_pipe(rt.max_size + 16)
+    assert not rt._uses_pipe(PIPE_BYTES + 16)
+    assert rt.should_allreduce(
+        torch.empty(PIPE_BYTES // 2, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=rt.device)
+    )
+    assert not rt.should_allreduce(
+        torch.empty(PIPE_BYTES // 2 + 8, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=rt.device)
+    )
+    for nbytes in (16, 16000, 1 << 20, PIPE_BYTES):
+        chunk_packs, chunks = rt._pipe_geometry(nbytes)
+        shard = -(-(nbytes // 16) // rt.world_size)
+        assert 1 <= chunks <= rt._layout.max_chunks and chunk_packs * chunks >= shard

+def test_graph_interleaves_oneshot_and_twoshot(runtime):
+    """One graph alternating both paths replays correctly; the slot records switch kinds every op."""
+    world, rank = dist.get_world_size(), dist.get_rank()
+    rt = runtime.runtime
+    torch.manual_seed(77 + rank)
+    small = torch.randn(32 * 1024, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=rt.device)
+    large = torch.randn(3 << 19, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=rt.device)
+    small_out, large_out = torch.empty_like(small), torch.empty_like(large)
+    expected_small, expected_large = small.clone(), large.clone()
+    dist.all_reduce(expected_small)
+    dist.all_reduce(expected_large)
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream(device=rt.device)
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        runtime.oneshot(small, out=small_out)
+        runtime.twoshot(large, out=large_out)
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph, stream=stream), rt.capture(stream=stream):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            runtime.oneshot(small, out=small_out)
+            runtime.twoshot(large, out=large_out)
+            runtime.twoshot(large, out=large_out)
+            runtime.oneshot(small, out=small_out)
+    for _ in range(5):
+        small_out.zero_()
+        large_out.zero_()
+        dist.barrier()
+        graph.replay()
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        rt.check_health()
+        rtol, atol = _tolerance(torch.bfloat16, world)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(small_out, expected_small, rtol=rtol, atol=atol)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(large_out, expected_large, rtol=rtol, atol=atol)
+        _rank_identical(large_out)
+    dist.barrier()

+def test_proxy_catches_up_on_mixed_doorbells(runtime):
+    """A proxy that misses a one-shot doorbell and the two-shot doorbell after it posts both.
+
+    Rank 1's one-shot kernel completes on its peers' payloads, so its two-shot
+    kernel rings before the stopped proxy saw the first op; the restarted proxy
+    must read each slot's own kind.
+    """
+    world, rank = dist.get_world_size(), dist.get_rank()
+    rt = runtime.runtime
+    torch.manual_seed(900 + rank)
+    first = torch.randn(4096, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=rt.device)
+    second = torch.randn(1 << 20, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=rt.device)
+    expected = [first.clone(), second.clone()]
+    for e in expected:
+        dist.all_reduce(e)
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    dist.barrier()
+    if rank == 1:
+        rt._proxy.stop()
+    outs = [runtime.oneshot(first), runtime.twoshot(second)]
+    if rank == 1:
+        posted = rt._proxy.stats()["last_seq"]
+        deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
+        while int(rt._ctrl_words[0].item()) != posted + 2:
+            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, "two-shot doorbell never rang"
+            time.sleep(0.001)
+        rt._proxy.start()
+    torch.cuda.synchronize()
+    rt.check_health()
+    rtol, atol = _tolerance(torch.bfloat16, world)
+    for out, exp in zip(outs, expected, strict=True):
+        torch.testing.assert_close(out, exp, rtol=rtol, atol=atol)
+    dist.barrier()
